measured: Read 2026-11-11 by hand at the commit the demand scan records for Twenty (twentyhq/twenty 1d561b8c73c984058a5121ec229f4805a2424a91; twin-world generated/demand.json), and at the bench task twenty-23785's commit e79b3365e8355a12eb49a5f49c21dd8e9541a1be, where the same calls stand at the lines named in each row's note. The scan lists no host for this vendor: Twenty's front reaches it through an src, which the scan's request sinks do not trace. Twenty asks only GET /, the name normalised first by twenty-shared's sanitizeURL (scheme, www. and a trailing slash removed); it never asks a size. Ruled out: twenty-website's FaviconLogo (the marketing site, not the product) and the twenty-apps Slack app (an opt-in app).
